blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: (colloquial) to burst out laughing, to roar with laughter
to begin to sob/blubber, to burst out sobbing
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: расхохота́ться — (colloquial) to burst out laughing, to roar with laughter; загреме́ть — to begin to thunder; заинтересова́ть — to (start to) interest, to concern; зарыда́ть — to begin to sob/blubber, to burst out sobbing.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to start muttering, to start mumbling
to start swimming, to start floating
to (begin to) howl, to raise a howl
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: забормота́ть — to start muttering, to start mumbling; потащи́ть — to start pulling; поплы́ть — to start swimming, to start floating; завы́ть — to (begin to) howl, to raise a howl.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: зашепта́ть — to begin to whisper; зашага́ть — to begin to walk; застона́ть — to start moaning; влете́ть — to fly into.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to begin to wave, to flap
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: заскрипе́ть — to begin to creak; опу́хнуть — to swell; возненави́деть — to hate, to start hating; замаха́ть — to begin to wave, to flap.
